claims.claim: The complete V30-side 0f monitor table has fourteen raw records.
The complete table has no entries for 0f31, 0f33, 0f39, or 0f3b.
The complete primary monitor table has no entries for 6c through 6f.
BRKFEM is encoded as 0f fe imm8 and BRKEM as 0f ff imm8.
Generic FPO1/FPO2/ESC string presence or absence establishes FPU opcode support.

fpo_non_evidence: Generic FPO1, FPO2, or ESC strings are not target authority. The monitor stores individual 8087 mnemonics including FADD and FMUL and has D8-DF records; 66/67 remain for M60c.
